A '''Encryption Algorithm Computer''' was a type of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] installed in [[Droid/Legends|droids]] such as the [[CZ-series secretary/comm droid]]. The computer's encryption algorithms made it difficult for a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] to extract data from the droid.<ref name="EGTD" />
